rationale: Despite a massive broad market rally (SPY +4.91%), BURL sold off immediately from its opening high ($249.08) on heavy relative volume (3.82x) and sits in the bottom quartile of its session range below VWAP ($241.07). The current shallow bounce to the 5m 9-EMA ($239.02) provides an asymmetric entry to short into relative weakness, with invalidation placed just above session VWAP and a target near intraday lows. This short exposure also helps balance the portfolio's heavy existing long commitment while risking less than $25 of the remaining daily loss budget.
